title: indigofera incarnata f. alba
intro: Indigofera incarnata f. alba, commonly known as Red Clover White, is a flowering plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae). It has been traditionally used to support women's health, particularly in alleviating menopausal symptoms such as hot flashes and night sweats, and may also benefit cardiovascular health by reducing cholesterol levels and improving blood lipid profiles. The therapeutic actions of Indigofera incarnata f. alba are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and estrogenic properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating conditions like osteoporosis and menopausal mood swings. The bioactive constituents of the plant include isoflavones, including biochanin A and formononetin, which are believed to be responsible for its health benefits.
